mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 66 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, with a waning crescent moon overhead.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new long-range vision, developed with extensive community input, will focus on strong neighborhoods, sustainable growth, and maintaining our local identity for years to come.

We have a full lineup including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, ART House 360 this evening, and Hop Haus Trivia happening later tonight. Looking ahead, join us for Puppets in the Park this Saturday at Century School Park.

In a report covering the week ending October 5, on October 3, Verona Police officers located an offender in a vehicle who was then arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm after an investigation into a stolen weapon.
Today at Culver's, enjoy the delicious Double Strawberry flavor. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:00 PM tonight.
